prompt: Implement `TTLCache` in ttl_cache.py. `TTLCache(capacity, ttl, clock=time.monotonic)` raises ValueError unless capacity is at least 1 and ttl is above 0. An entry expires once clock() minus the time it was written is at least ttl. `get(key, default=None)` returns a live value and makes it the most recently used, without extending its expiry. `put(key, value)` on an existing key replaces the value, restarts its expiry and makes it most recently used. When `put` adds a new key to a full cache, drop any expired entries first, and evict the least recently used entry only if the cache is still full. `len(cache)` counts live entries only.
